aiResearchSummary.text: BotBuilt is advancing robotic systems for home construction, focusing on autonomous systems for installing nail plates in wooden structures, as described in 'System and method for installing nail plates in wooden structures.' They are also developing systems for automated framing construction, which includes robotic assistance in building structures like walls and roofs, as detailed in 'Systems and methods for automated framing construction.' These innovations highlight BotBuilt's commitment to integrating robotics and AI in simplifying construction processes.
